Building systems. Learning continuously. Living intentionally. This site is where I document the work, the lessons, and the life around them.

Lab work

A lot of what I know comes from breaking and rebuilding things in Hyper-V and nested ESXi. These are the environments I've built so far — open one to see how it's wired.

01

Virtualized Enterprise Lab

Enterprise Topology +

NAT/firewall routing, multi-DC design, Linux DHCP, DNS, SAN/iSCSI and failover testing using Hyper-V and VMware/ESXi.

Hyper-V · ESXi · Multi-DC · NAT/Firewall

WAN / ISP gateway (10.0.0.1)
 └─ pfSense — NAT & firewall
     ├─ VLAN 10  192.168.10.0/24   workstations
     ├─ VLAN 20  192.168.20.0/24   domain controllers, servers
     └─ VLAN 30  192.168.30.0/24   isolated management & SAN
$ pfctl -sr | grep pass
02

Active Directory — Users, OUs & GPO

Identity & Policy +

Structured OU design, security groups, permissions and policy-based workstation/user settings.

AD DS · GPO · RBAC · OU Hierarchy

corp.local
 └─ OU  Toronto
     ├─ OU  Workstations   GPO: BitLocker, LAPS, firewall baseline
     ├─ OU  Users          security groups, tiered access
     └─ OU  Servers        DC01 + DC02 DFSR replication
$ Get-ADOrganizationalUnit -Filter * | select DistinguishedName
03

DNS — Primary/Secondary + AD-Integrated Zones

Name Resolution +

Service configuration, zone design and troubleshooting.

DNS Zones · Replication · Forwarders · PTR

client ──> AD-integrated DNS (192.168.20.10 / .11)
 ├─ zone   corp.local   secure dynamic updates + PTR
 └─ forwarders          1.1.1.1 / 9.9.9.9
$ Resolve-DnsName dc01.corp.local -Server 192.168.20.10
04

DHCP — Linux + Advanced DHCP Service

IP Address Management +

Scope planning, options, reservations and validation in a segmented environment.

Linux DHCP · VLAN Scopes · Reservations · Relay

Ubuntu Server — isc-dhcp-server
 ├─ scope VLAN 10   192.168.10.50 – .200   24h lease
 ├─ scope VLAN 20   192.168.20.50 – .100
 └─ reservations    printers, management interfaces
$ systemctl status isc-dhcp-server && dhcp-lease-list
05

Storage — SAN + iSCSI + RAID

Block Storage & Redundancy +

iSCSI connectivity and redundancy testing, including multi-disk failure scenarios.

SAN · iSCSI Target/Initiator · RAID · MPIO

TrueNAS target — RAID 10
 └─ iSCSI portal :3260 (storage subnet)
     ├─ Hyper-V host 01   MPIO path A
     └─ Hyper-V host 02   MPIO path B
$ iscsicli ListTargets
06

Failover Cluster — File Servers + Shared Storage

High Availability +

Cluster design, shared storage using VHD Set, and availability testing.

Failover Clustering · VHD Set · Quorum · SMB

node 01 (file server) <── heartbeat ──> node 02 (file server)
 └─ shared VHD Set on iSCSI storage + file share witness
$ Get-ClusterNode; Get-ClusterResource
07

VMware ESXi — Nested Build & Management

Hypervisor Infrastructure +

Workstation and nested ESXi environment setup for repeatable lab workflows.

VMware ESXi · vSwitch · Nested Virtualization

physical host
 └─ nested VMware ESXi 8.0
     ├─ vSwitch0   management (vmk0)
     └─ vSwitch1   lab trunk, 802.1Q tagged
$ esxcli network vswitch standard list

Not a perfect roadmap. Just the path that actually happened.
